description: This is a Java interface defining the LogicService, which provides methods for registering, managing, and evaluating logic rules within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It includes methods for rule management, evaluation against patients and cohorts, tagging, and data source retrieval.

methods.name: getAllTokens
methods.description: Returns all registered tokens in the logic service.

methods.name: getTokens
methods.description: Retrieves tokens matching a given partial string, either fully or partially.

methods.name: addRule
methods.description: Registers a new rule with the specified token.

methods.name: addRule
methods.description: Registers a new rule with the specified token and associated tags.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Fetches the rule registered under a specific token.

methods.name: updateRule
methods.description: Updates an existing rule registered under a specific token.

methods.name: removeRule
methods.description: Removes a rule from the logic service.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a rule for a patient given a token expression.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a rule with parameters for a patient given a token expression.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a rule for a patient using LogicCriteria.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a rule for a patient with LogicCriteria and parameters.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates multiple expressions for a single patient.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates multiple LogicCriteria for a single patient.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a query over a cohort for a single expression.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a query over a cohort with parameters.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a query over a cohort using LogicCriteria.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a query over a cohort with LogicCriteria and parameters.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates multiple LogicCriteria over a cohort.

methods.name: addTokenTag
methods.description: Adds a tag to a specific token.

methods.name: removeTokenTag
methods.description: Removes a tag from a token.

methods.name: getTokenTags
methods.description: Retrieves all tags associated with a token.

methods.name: getTokensWithTag
methods.description: Retrieves all tokens associated with a specific tag.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Performs a partial match search for tags among known tokens.

methods.name: getDefaultDatatype
methods.description: Returns the default datatype for a given token.

methods.name: getParameterList
methods.description: Gets the list of parameters expected for a specific rule token.

methods.name: getLogicDataSources
methods.description: Retrieves all registered logic data sources.

methods.name: getLogicDataSource
methods.description: Fetches a logic data source by its name.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a String expression into a LogicCriteria object.
